caption:
So I tried to get Claude to build this website. Look at this — the 3D animations, the glitch effects, the moving graphics.

And Claude just… can’t do it. Not like this. Not with a normal prompt.

Why? Because out of the box, Claude doesn’t know how to do fancy 3D stuff. It’s not built into it. You need the right tool for that.

Here’s the secret: there’s one specific tool I use to build sites like this — and it changes everything.

Once you find it, it goes from ‘okay website’ to ‘wow, how did you build that?’

Want to know what it is? Comment “SKILLS” below 👇 and I’ll show you exactly what I use.
